description:
Job Overview As a Game Animator, you'll be the centre of creativity to design our games. You'll illustrate ideas, build prototypes, create interactive and attractive game animation. Game Animators work as part of a multidisciplinary team that includes games producers, game developers, game artists and game testers.
Key Responsibilities
● Create animation using Spine.
● Support Game Producer in Game UI/UX, idealizing the visual look, transition timing to optimize game animation.
● Work closely with Game Producer and Game Developers to import the animation.
requirements_text:
Must Have Skills And Experience
* Be fluent in designing softwares such as Spine, Adobe Photoshop, Illustration, After FX, etc.
* Knowledge or experience in Game UI/UX.
* High drawing performance, fast delivery.
* Be able to apply/design/draw Particle animation.
* Be creative and original.
* Understand the operation mechanism of game engine animation.
* Resistant to high pressure at work.
* Have a good product mindset (Ability to understand and experience as a real user on the games they built).
* Have the ability to work independently and work in a team.
* Orientate and coordinate team activities.
* Be a good team player.
Prefer If Candidate Have
* 3-4 years of Animator experience.
* Portfolio of sample projects.
* Enthusiasm and knowledge of the online game industry.
